verified_facts.text: The hotel is at 1 West 28th Street, at the corner of Fifth Avenue and West 28th Street in Manhattan's NoMad neighborhood.
verified_facts.excerpt: at the corner of Fifth Avenue and West 28th Street in Manhattan’s NoMad (North of Madison Square Park) neighborhood

verified_facts.text: The hotel is within walking distance of Madison Square Park, the Flatiron Building, the Empire State Building, Fifth Avenue shopping, Eataly and Koreatown.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel is within walking distance of Madison Square Park, the Flatiron Building, Empire State Building, Fifth Avenue shopping, Eataly, Koreatown

verified_facts.text: The hotel combines a restored 1907 landmark mansion with a contemporary glass tower beside it.
verified_facts.excerpt: the restored 1907 landmark stands beside a contemporary glass tower

verified_facts.text: After a 10-year restoration by Flâneur Hospitality, the original brick and limestone Renaissance-style palazzo is joined by a 24-story modern glass tower.
verified_facts.excerpt: following a 10-year restoration by Flâneur Hospitality, the original brick and limestone Renaissance-style palazzo is complemented by a shimmering 24-story modern glass tower

verified_facts.text: The hotel is built on the former estate of Mrs. Charlotte Goodridge, a Gilded Age hostess.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Fifth Avenue Hotel is built on the former estate of Mrs. Charlotte Goodridge, a legendary Gilded Age hostess

verified_facts.text: The mansion housed a fine art gallery before architects McKim, Mead & White reimagined it as the Second National Bank.
verified_facts.excerpt: The mansion then housed a fine art gallery before being reimagined by legendary architectural firm McKim, Mead & White as the stately Second National Bank.

verified_facts.text: Designer Martin Brudnizki brought both the mansion and the tower to life in rich palettes and worldly curiosities.
verified_facts.excerpt: with Martin Brudnizki bringing both to life in rich palettes and worldly curiosities

verified_facts.text: Pae White's Bugs & Drugs tapestry hangs in the lobby.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pae White’s Bugs & Drugs tapestry invites wonder into the lobby

verified_facts.text: Photographs by William Klein, Gordon Parks and Melvin Sokolsky hang on the walls.
verified_facts.excerpt: Photographs by William Klein, Gordon Parks, and Melvin Sokolsky adorn the walls

verified_facts.text: Signature Suites have a garden terrace with a view of Manhattan.
verified_facts.excerpt: Entertain (or retreat) on a verdant garden terrace with a vista of Manhattan as your backdrop in one of our lavishly sized Signature Suites

verified_facts.text: All rooms have marble bathrooms, stocked maxibars, Nespresso coffee makers and a personal tablet to manage the room.
verified_facts.excerpt: All rooms have generously sized marble bathrooms and amenities including thoughtfully stocked maxibars, Nespresso coffee makers and a personal tablet to manage your comfort

verified_facts.text: Beds are made up with fine Italian linens.
verified_facts.excerpt: our divine beds made up with fine Italian linens

verified_facts.text: Each room has complimentary soft drinks and snacks, high-speed Wi-Fi and a personal tablet.
verified_facts.excerpt: a personal tablet, high-speed Wi-Fi, and complimentary soft drinks and snacks in each room

verified_facts.text: Guests have access to the hotel's luxury house car.
verified_facts.excerpt: access to our luxury house car and thoughtful concierge service

verified_facts.text: Guests can reach a butler by text.
verified_facts.excerpt: a butler by text, a Maxi Bar already stocked, a house car waiting below

verified_facts.text: The Portrait Bar is named for the collection of artwork on its wood-paneled walls.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Portrait Bar, named for the exceptional collection of artwork that adorns its wood-paneled walls

verified_facts.text: Café Carmellini welcomes both hotel guests and visitors, and reservations are recommended.
verified_facts.excerpt: Café Carmellini welcomes both hotel guests and visitors. Reservations are recommended.

verified_facts.text: Around-the-clock butler attendance is included.
verified_facts.excerpt: Around-the-clock butler attendance is included here.

verified_facts.text: Guests can order a martini ritual to their room, where a martini butler stirs or shakes the drink.
verified_facts.excerpt: don’t miss the martini ritual which any guest can order to their room between 5:00 and 7:00 p.m. Simply pick from a choice of ‘Blue’ gin or ‘Axberg’ vodka, and a martini butler will arrive

verified_facts.text: The flâneur suite has a terrace with a Japanese garden and a soaking tub overlooking the New York skyline.
verified_facts.excerpt: the flâneur suite that is accompanied by a palatial terrace complete with a Japanese garden with a soaking tub overlooking the New York skyline

verified_facts.text: Public spaces are in the mansion, while most rooms and suites are in the modern glass tower.
verified_facts.excerpt: While public spaces are situated in the main mansion, most rooms and suites are contained within the modern glass tower next door.

verified_facts.text: Mansion suites are detailed with hand-molded stucco and crown detailing.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Mansion suites—one of which I had the pleasure of staying in—are richly detailed with hand-molded stucco and crown detailing

verified_facts.text: Corridors are covered in vivid wallpaper with oversized flora and animals, real and mythical.
verified_facts.excerpt: Corridors are bedecked in vivid wallpaper with oversized flora and animals, real and mythical

verified_facts.text: Connecting rooms are available for families and traveling companions.
verified_facts.excerpt: For families and traveling companions, our adjoining rooms conveniently offer connection and/or privacy.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers ADA-compliant rooms and suites.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests will feel perfectly at home in our spacious ADA-compliant rooms and suites

verified_facts.text: The hotel received Two Keys in the MICHELIN Hotel Guide 2024 and 2025.
verified_facts.excerpt:
MICHELIN Hotel Guide 2024 & 2025
